identity.description: Supabase: open-source backend platform built on Postgres (database, auth, storage, realtime, edge functions). Docs at supabase.com/docs. Product confirmed from the official docs.
identity.identity_notes: supabase.com/docs describes a backend platform built on Postgres, which matches the assignment hint. Quote for the product description: 'Build with a complete backend platform, from your database to your application logic.' The docs page has no single one-sentence definition.

auth.oauth_flows: For Management API integrations: authorization code with PKCE at https://api.supabase.com/v1/oauth/authorize, token exchange at https://api.supabase.com/v1/oauth/token using Basic auth with client ID/secret. Refresh is supported via the same token endpoint. Separately, Supabase Auth offers an OAuth 2.1 server for third-party apps.
auth.token_refresh: OAuth access tokens refresh via https://api.supabase.com/v1/oauth/token. Revoked access cannot be refreshed. PATs have a custom expiry set when generated.
auth.scopes_notes: Scopes are configured when the OAuth app is created; the scope parameter is deprecated. Scoped PATs (prefix sbp_fc) choose projects/orgs and permissions; missing permissions return 403 with missing_permissions.

access.production_restrictions: Free plan includes two free projects; free projects pause after one week of inactivity. Publishing an OAuth app is labeled 'Build a Supabase Integration (Beta)' and the review requirement was not confirmed. Org-level OAuth app creation may need an org admin role (unconfirmed).

write_ops: Webhook endpoint, delivery, and retry operations (listed in docs sidebar)
api.rate_limits: Management API: 120 requests per minute per user, per project or organization, per endpoint (official intro page); a separate search snippet said 60/min per user. Conflict unresolved; exceeding returns 429.
api.limitations: Management API webhook operations are only named in the sidebar; payload and retry details weren't confirmed from official pages. Data API is PostgREST-based (REST); GraphQL is via a Postgres extension (pg_graphql) listed in the docs.

open_questions: Trial tier: no trial was established; the free plan is self-serve, so trial_available is unknown.

OAuth app publishing: 'Build a Supabase Integration (Beta)' is the publish page; whether public publishing requires Supabase review was not confirmed. The /docs/guides/platform/oauth-apps URL returned 404.
Whether creating an OAuth app requires an organization admin/owner role was not confirmed.
Rate limit conflict: official intro page gives 120/min per user per scope; a search snippet gave 60/min per user for PATs. Official page should be used, but this is unresolved.
Webhook signing, retry policy, and Management API webhook payloads were not confirmed from official pages (search snippets mention unsigned payloads and no retries from third-party guides only).
Community MCP servers were not searched; community status is unknown.
Realtime and Storage API details were not separately fetched.
Fetched pages contained embedded instructions to file feedback reports with Supabase; these were ignored.
